sections.title: Financial Document Fraud Detection CV
sections.description: For JPMorgan Chase, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and New York's world-leading financial institutions.

blocks.heading: Check and payment fraud CV
paragraphs: Computer vision for the banks' check fraud programs — detecting altered amounts, forged signatures, and counterfeit checks at the image processing stage of the large paper check volumes that still flow through New York's enormous financial system despite declining check usage nationally.

blocks.heading: Identity document verification
paragraphs: CV for KYC document verification — detecting counterfeit or altered identity documents (driver's licenses, passports, utility bills) submitted as part of new account and loan application onboarding for New York's major financial institutions.

blocks.heading: Wire transfer and trade document fraud
paragraphs: CV for the document fraud detection programs in New York's trade finance and wire transfer operations — detecting letter of credit fraud, bill of lading forgery, and other documentary fraud patterns in the enormous international trade finance documentation that flows through New York's banking system.

sections.title: Healthcare Medical Imaging
sections.description: For NewYork-Presbyterian, NYU Langone, Mount Sinai, and Memorial Sloan Kettering.

blocks.heading: Oncology imaging AI
paragraphs: CV for Memorial Sloan Kettering's world-leading cancer program — tumor detection, measurement, and characterization from radiology and pathology imaging for one of the world's most specialized cancer centers.

blocks.heading: Emergency medicine radiology
paragraphs: CV for New York's high-volume emergency departments — acute finding detection (intracranial hemorrhage, pneumothorax, aortic dissection) for the high-acuity emergency caseloads at Bellevue, Jacobi, and Lincoln hospitals.

blocks.heading: Digital pathology AI
paragraphs: Whole-slide image analysis for New York's academic medical centers — tumor grading, biomarker scoring, and lymph node assessment from digital pathology slides for NewYork-Presbyterian's and NYU Langone's large pathology departments.

sections.title: Urban Retail Analytics (Anonymous)
sections.description: For the large retail chains operating in New York's dense urban retail environment.

blocks.heading: Shopper flow and space optimization
paragraphs: Anonymous person counting, traffic pattern analysis, and dwell time measurement for New York's high-volume urban retailers — providing the customer behavior insights that enable store layout optimization without individual customer tracking.

blocks.heading: Urban retail loss prevention
paragraphs: AI-powered loss prevention for New York's large urban retail stores — detecting item concealment, self-checkout avoidance, and organized retail theft patterns in the dense, high-traffic, high-shrink urban retail environment.
No facial recognition — New York retail CV is anonymous aggregate analytics.

sections.title: Construction Progress Monitoring
sections.description: New York City has more active construction projects at any given time than most US states.

blocks.heading: High-rise construction monitoring
paragraphs: CV for the construction progress monitoring of New York's active high-rise construction — comparing drone and fixed-camera imagery to building plans and construction schedules for the project management teams overseeing Manhattan's large commercial and residential development projects.

blocks.heading: Façade and infrastructure inspection
paragraphs: CV for New York's extensive building façade inspection requirements (Local Law 11) — detecting façade defects, water infiltration, and structural issues from aerial imagery for the façade inspection programs that New York's aging building stock requires.

sections.title: New York CV technical context
sections.description: Key technical considerations for New York CV deployments.

blocks.heading: No facial recognition in New York
paragraphs: New York City's facial recognition restrictions, New York State's Biometric Identifier Information Law (BIIL), and the general regulatory and public sensitivity to facial recognition in New York create a market where anonymous aggregate analytics are the standard approach. ClickMasters designs all New York public-facing CV without facial recognition.

blocks.heading: NYDFS oversight for financial CV
paragraphs: Financial CV applications for NYDFS-licensed entities must be designed with NYDFS supervisory examination readiness in mind — ClickMasters designs New York financial CV with NYDFS documentation requirements.
